scripts.build: if [ "$DIFFGAZER_SKIP_ARTIFACT_PREPARE" != "1" ]; then pnpm run prepare:artifacts; fi && DIFFGAZER_SKIP_ARTIFACT_PREPARE=1 pnpm exec turbo run build
scripts.check: biome check scripts/monorepo package.json turbo.json biome.json knip.jsonc .dependency-cruiser.cjs && node scripts/monorepo/check-deploy-runbooks.mjs && turbo run check && pnpm run depcruise && pnpm run knip
scripts.verify: sh scripts/monorepo/run-with-artifacts.sh sh -c 'pnpm run verify:monorepo && pnpm run validate:artifacts:check && pnpm run secret-scan && pnpm run check && pnpm run test:scripts && turbo run type-check && turbo run test --continue=dependencies-successful && turbo run test:types && pnpm run smoke && pnpm run bench'
scripts.release-check: sh scripts/monorepo/run-with-artifacts.sh sh -c 'pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high && pnpm run secret-scan && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:packages && pnpm run validate:artifacts:check && pnpm run check && pnpm run test:scripts && turbo run type-check && turbo run test --continue=dependencies-successful --concurrency=2 && turbo run test:types --concurrency=2 && pnpm run smoke:packages && pnpm --filter @diffgazer/web exec playwright test testing/e2e/providers.e2e.ts --project=chromium && pnpm --filter @diffgazer/docs build && pnpm run check:changesets && pnpm --filter @diffgazer/add pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @diffgazer/ui pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter @diffgazer/keys pack --dry-run && pnpm --filter diffgazer pack --dry-run && pnpm run verify:monorepo && node --test scripts/monorepo/provider-transport-legacy-allowlist.test.mjs && git diff --check'
scripts.prepare:library-artifacts: pnpm --filter @diffgazer/core generate:catalog-snapshot && turbo run build --filter=@diffgazer/registry --filter=@diffgazer/keys --filter=@diffgazer/ui && pnpm --filter @diffgazer/add generate:bundles && pnpm --filter @diffgazer/add generate:schema && node --import tsx cli/add/scripts/copy-generated.ts
scripts.prepare:artifacts: pnpm run prepare:library-artifacts && DIFFGAZER_SKIP_ARTIFACT_PREPARE=1 pnpm --filter @diffgazer/docs prepare:generated
scripts.smoke: pnpm --filter diffgazer build && pnpm run smoke:cli && pnpm run smoke:packages && pnpm run smoke:shadcn && pnpm run smoke:modelsdev && pnpm run smoke:review
scripts.smoke:review: turbo run build --filter=@diffgazer/server && node --import tsx scripts/monorepo/smoke-review.mjs
scripts.bench: turbo run build --filter=@diffgazer/server && node --import tsx scripts/monorepo/benchmark-server.mjs
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm run prepare:library-artifacts && turbo run build --filter=@diffgazer/core --filter=@diffgazer/server && pnpm --filter diffgazer build:bundle && pnpm --filter diffgazer build:notices
